content.text: IVIG (1–2 g/kg over 2–7 days) has shown efficacy in steroid-resistant cases or flares during steroid taper; used more often in children, esp < 6 y; its role is uncertain (no controlled trials).
Severe DRESS w life-threatening complications (multiorgan, respiratory failure, cardiac): plasmapheresis may be considered when other tx fail.
